```{r set-project-root}
#| results: false

```

```{r activating-packages}
#| results: false

# List of required packages
packages <- c(
  "tidyverse",
  "dplyr",
  "tidyr",
  "ggplot2",
  "psycho"        # Used for calculating hits, misses, etc. and d'

}

```

## Import Raw Data

### Set data directory

```{r set-raw-data-dir}

behavioural_data_dir <- here(
  "2. Raw Data and Videos",
  "1. Behavioural_Data"
)

```

### Import Data

```{r import-data}

# List all CSV files in the directory
behavioural_files <- list.files(
  path = behavioural_data_dir,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

length(behavioural_files)

# Read in and process each file
behavioural_list <- lapply(behavioural_files, function(file) {
  df <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    select(-matches("^\\.\\.\\.\\d+$"))  # drop unnamed columns (...1, ...2, etc.)
  
  if ("occupation_task_hours" %in% names(df)) {
    df <- df %>% mutate(occupation_task_hours = as.character(occupation_task_hours))
  }
  
  if ("num_years_instrument" %in% names(df)) {
    df <- df %>% mutate(num_years_instrument = as.character(num_years_instrument))
  }
  
  if ("group" %in% names(df)) {
    df <- df %>% mutate(group = as.character(group))
  }
  
  df
})

# Combine into one dataframe, recording which file each row came from
names(behavioural_list) <- basename(behavioural_files)
beh_df <- bind_rows(behavioural_list)
```

### Check Data Quality

```{r inspect-data}

head(beh_df)
```

## Accuracy

### Overall Accuracy

```{r mean-overall-accuracy}

mean_overall_accuracy <- mean(beh_df$corr)
mean_overall_accuracy
```

```{r overall-accuracy-participant}

overall_accuracy_participant <- beh_df %>%
  group_by(participant) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(corr),
            std = sd(corr))

knitr::kable(
  overall_accuracy_participant,
  col.names = c("Participant", "Mean", "Standard Deviation")
)
```

```{r plot-overall-accuracy-participant}

ggplot(overall_accuracy_participant,
       aes(x = factor(participant), y = mean)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, col = "darkslategray4", fill = "darkslategray4") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = "Participant", y = "Mean accuracy") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(beh_df$corr), colour = "#F8766D", linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

### Accuracy Same vs Different Trials

Overall accuracy per trial type (same trials versus different trials)

```{r accuracy-same-diff}

diff_accuracy <- mean(beh_df$corr[beh_df$trial_type == "diff"])
same_accuracy <- mean(beh_df$corr[beh_df$trial_type == "same"])
```

The mean accuracy for same trials (zero-step neighbour) is `r round(diff_accuracy*100, 2)`%.

The mean accuracy for different trials (two-step neighbour) is `r round(same_accuracy*100, 2)`%.

```{r accuracy-same-diff-participant}

accuracy_same_diff_participant <- beh_df %>%
  group_by(participant, trial_type) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(corr),
            std = sd(corr))

knitr::kable(
  accuracy_same_diff_participant,
  col.names = c("Participant", "Trial Type", "Mean", "Standard Deviation")
)

```

```{r plot-accuracy-same-diff-participant}

ggplot(accuracy_same_diff_participant,
       aes(x = factor(participant), y = mean, fill = trial_type)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = "Participant", y = "Mean accuracy", fill = "Trial type") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(beh_df$corr[beh_df$trial_type == "diff"]), colour = "#F8766D", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(beh_df$corr[beh_df$trial_type == "same"]), colour = "#00BFC4", linetype = "dashed") +     
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Hits, Misses, False Alarms, Correct Rejections

Now we need to calculate hits, misses, false alarms, and correct rejections. I am going define this in terms of "same" trials, i.e. a hit is the correct identification of a same trial.

```{r define-hits-misses-fa-cj}

signal_det <- beh_df %>%
  group_by(participant) %>%
  summarise(hits = sum(trial_type == "same" & key_resp == "s"),
            misses = sum(trial_type == "same" & key_resp == "d"),
            fa = sum(trial_type == "diff" & key_resp == "s"),
            corr_rej = sum(trial_type == "diff" & key_resp == "d")) %>%
  mutate(dprime = dprime(n_hit = hits, n_fa = fa, 
                         n_miss = misses, n_cr = corr_rej)$dprime,
         c = dprime(n_hit = hits, 
                    n_fa = fa, n_miss = misses, n_cr = corr_rej)$c)

```

```{r beh_df-table}

knitr::kable(
  signal_det,
  col.names = c("Participant", "Hits", "Misses", "False Alarms", "Correct Rejections", "d'", "c")
)
```

```{r plot-dprime}

ggplot(signal_det,
       aes(x = factor(participant), y = dprime)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  # scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = "Participant", y = "d'") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

```{r plot-bias}

ggplot(signal_det,
       aes(x = factor(participant), y = c)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  # scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = "Participant", y = "Bias (c)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
